newsitem.title: USA: Audi prices 1998 A4 sedan starting at $28,120.
newsitem.headline: Audi prices 1998 A4 sedan starting at $28,120.

text.p: Audi of America Inc, a unit of Volkswagen AG, said Monday the U.S. base price on its 1998 A4 2.8 sedan is $28,120, up from $27,430 for the 1997 model.
The 1998 model includes a 2.8 liter double overhead cam V-6 engine, with five valves per cylinder and variable intake valve timing, Audi said in a statement.

While available in both Audi's FrontTrak front wheel drive and quattro full-time all wheel drive, front wheel drive A4's now include a standard anti-slip regulation system giving the driver full-time, all-speed traction control, Audi said.

Standard features include fully automatic climate control system with sun intensity control and pollen filter, power central locking system, 60/40 split folding rear seatbacks with individual locks, leather wrapped shift knob and steering wheel, power windows and heated outside mirrors, front and rear foglights and genuine walnut wood trim.
